name: inline-headroom
description: Headroom-style levers inside Claude Code as a mod: clamp-only effort routing after successful tool results, a detector-only CacheAligner that flags volatile system-prompt content and cache-hit drops, and a SmartCrusher that compresses large JSON arrays in tool results. Ships a host-wide SQLite storage MCP server for persistent plugin data.

cache_aligner_enabled.title: CacheAligner
cache_aligner_enabled.description: Flag volatile values (UUID, ISO-8601, JWT, hex hash) in the cacheable system-prompt sections and log prompt-cache hit-ratio drops. Never rewrites the prompt.

effort_routing_enabled.title: Effort routing
effort_routing_enabled.description: Lower thinking effort to low on main-loop steps that only resume after successful tool results. Never raises or injects effort. Note: an effort switch may invalidate prompt cache.

subagent_effort_routing_enabled.title: Subagent effort routing
subagent_effort_routing_enabled.description: Also lower thinking effort to low on subagent and Workflow-agent steps that only resume after that agent's successful tool results. Only active while effort routing is on. Overrides effort set on purpose (agent frontmatter, Agent tool or Workflow effort), and each subagent may pay its own prompt-cache re-write per switch.

smart_crusher_enabled.title: SmartCrusher
smart_crusher_enabled.description: Compress large JSON arrays in successful Bash and MCP tool results (headroom SmartCrusher): keeps first/last, error, outlier, anomaly and query-relevant rows; dropped rows stay retrievable via headroom_retrieve while the mod is loaded. Never rewrites error results.

storage_enabled.title: Persistent storage
storage_enabled.description: Run the host-wide SQLite storage service (one background process per host; data in the plugin data directory, kept across updates). Fail-closed: only true enables it.
